query: select jsonb_build_object('captured_at',now(),'artifact_key',p.artifact_key,'published_at',p.published_at,'sha256',p.payload_sha256,'rows',(select jsonb_agg((select jsonb_object_agg(k,v) from jsonb_each(x) e(k,v) where k in ('date','pitcher','side','team','opp_team','game_time','result','actual_ks','pnl','odds','k_line','locked_at','locked_odds','locked_k_line','locked_verdict','verdict','raw_verdict','actionable_verdict','quality_gate_level','input_quality_flags','data_complete','data_maturity','lineup_used','avg_ip','recent_k9','season_k9','career_k9','last_pitch_count','days_since_last_start','is_opener','raw_lambda','applied_lambda','confidence_referee','market_anchor_selector','ref_book','batter_handedness_mode','lineup_real_split_count','lineup_path_a_fallback_count','lineup_split_source','official_line_source_provider','official_odds_source','fetched_at'))) from jsonb_array_elements(p.payload) x where x->>'date' between '2026-07-24' and '2026-09-03')) as evidence from public.published_pipeline_artifacts p where artifact_key='picks_history'
